lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with larger, more isolated blobs in the mid-upper flank and smaller, more densely packed blobs approaching the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clearly visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs, forming a distinct grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high pixel intensity on the upper edge to lower intensity shadow directly below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-count, high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin features three prominent, high-intensity transverse bands localized near the leading edge.
